description: This file implements user login functionality, including validation, database lookup, password verification, token generation, and response encapsulation within the Conduit project.

classes.name: Login.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object containing user email and password for login.

classes.name: Login.Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating user data for login, implementing MediatR's IRequest.

classes.name: Login.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator ensuring the command's user data fields are not null or empty.

classes.name: Login.Handler
classes.description: Handles login requests by validating credentials, generating JWT tokens, and returning user data.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the login process: fetches user by email, verifies password, generates token, and returns user envelope.
